title: Pin Valley, Spiti: Mudh Village, Pin Valley National Park and the Kungri Monastery
seo_title: Pin Valley, Spiti: Mudh Village, National Park & How to Reach
seo_desc: Pin Valley in Spiti: Pin Valley National Park (set up in 1987) for ibex and snow leopards, Mudh village at the road's end (about 50 km from Kaza), Kungri monastery, the Pin–Parvati and Pin–Bhaba treks, and the best time to go.
focus: pin valley, mudh village, pin valley national park
